Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: Four Falls of Buffalo
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Animals at Play: The Power of Play (S1E1). Documentary about nature. England, 2019. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1 «Animals at Play»…Across the natural world, young animals spend much of their time playing. From cats that love a game of chase to chimps that can solve puzzles, new research now reveals that play is at the heart of almost everything an animal learns. And some unexpected species are getting in on all the fun and games. In the jungles of Thailand, clouded leopard cubs are chasing, climbing, jumping on each other and play fighting. And they play these same games over and over again. But why? It is all about the release of dopamine and endorphins – the body's reward chemicals. They give the animals a feel-good factor, which makes these games highly addictive. And that repetition is vital. The more they play, the more they hone their skills and eventually these cubs will become formidable tree-based hunters. But play isn't practiced by just a few species. Scientist are discovering that it is a lot more widespread than previously thought. Even some reptiles have an appetite for fun. The komodo dragon is the largest lizard on earth and a cold-blooded killer to boot. Professor Gordon Burghardt has been studying them in captivity for the last 20 years and has started to see their playful side. Using objects like paper bags and buckets, he has observed that they like playing with things on their heads and it led him to wonder what they might gain from doing this. He thinks it might replicate their feeding behaviour – burying their heads deep inside a carcass to get food. It is one of the first examples of play behaviour ever recorded in a reptile. Komodo dragons aren't the only unexpected animals that love playtime. From juggling otters to sledging crows, scientists are discovering that play is a serious pastime across the natural world and some animals are willing to risk their lives to do it. In the forests of Thailand, Gibbons hurl themselves huge distances through the canopy. It is a daredevil method of locomotion called brachiating. But 15 metres up, one slip could prove fatal and it is something that the gibbons have to be prepared for. So, to really get to grips with their treetop world juveniles take an enormous risk. It is thought they allow themselves to fall by momentarily letting go of the branches. It is a risky tactic but one that teaches them how to react if they fall for real. It isn't just how animals play that matters, it is what they play with that could prove critical to their survival in the wild. Young carnivores are among the most playful animals on the planet and science suggests there's a good reason for that. Their lives depend on their ability to hunt and they like to practice on objects. Marlice Van Vuuren has been looking after orphaned cheetahs for over 30 years and she uses object play to train them for their return to the wild. A game of ball is perfect for helping them learn how to chase down objects that move in unpredictable ways. They also need to make split-second decisions about when to pursue prey and when to call it quits. To sharpen their decision-making skills, Marlice uses an industrial sized game of cat and mouse otherwise known as a lure. It gives her cheetah a mental work out as well as a physical one – helping them assess when they are likely to catch prey. So, for predators, play is a mental work out as well as a physical one. And in some species, it doesn't just give the brain a work out, it could cause parts of the brain to grow. The African elephant has one of the longest and most playful childhoods in the animal kingdom. For the first eight years of its life, a calf will rarely stray from its mother's side and with food on tap, they have plenty and time and energy for playing. Scientists now think it helps elephant develop complex social skills, making them one of the most intelligent mammals in the animal kingdom. The power of play isn't just for the young. programme.title: Surviving the Amazon: A Life Among Trees (S1E3). Documentary about nature, adventure. England, 2019. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S1, Ep3 «Surviving the Amazon»…Brand new series: Over 300 billion trees pump out oxygen in the Amazon, and each one is an individual thriving ecosystem, home to a bustling community of dozens of animal species. At night, the trees switch to carbon dioxide production while, on their lower branches, nocturnal snakes hunt juicy frogs. Spiders use the trees' giant buttress roots as anchor points for their webs, ensnaring much of their prey at night. And owl monkeys, the world's only nocturnal monkey, search for insects. As the sun rises and the trees start to make oxygen again, the world's smallest monkey, the pygmy marmoset, use their sharp teeth to carve out holes in the bark that constantly refill with refreshing sap. Every tree in the Amazon is home to a living soap opera | You will be blown away by the breathtaking scenery and enormous variety of flora and fauna species. Majestic trees, strange birds, freshwater dolphins and manatee, jaguars and monkeys, all this and so much more you can find in the Amazon rain-forests | Director: Nuala Carr | Cast: Oddie Braddell

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World
programme.desc: Researchers are certain: We are currently experiencing the worst species extinction since the end of the dinosaurs. Animal filmmaker Andreas Kieling explores threatened habitats on three continents and speaks to researchers and animal rights activists. \n\nThe island of Madagascar, where Kieling observes ring-tailed lemurs, is almost a continent in itself. The jungle home of this lemur species is threatened by deforestation. In Alaska's Denali National Park, climate change is causing problems for many species - including the last 49 wolves that live and hunt there.

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World
programme.desc: 15,000 orangutans live in Sumatra today: - sixty percent fewer than in 1985. Kieling visits the Bukit Tigapuluh National Park, where orphaned great apes are made fit for the wild. In Iceland he tags young puffins with ornithologists.

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World
programme.desc: Andreas Kieling visits the last giant sea eagles on the Japanese island of Hokkaido. In Africa it approaches gorillas and in Alaska it approaches clam-eating coastal brown bears. A cat is on the program in Germany: the lynx.

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Premiere at Taronga Zoo: For the first time in ten years, the zoo's veterinarians get closer to a silverback. Meanwhile, an injured albatross urgently needs help. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: In Australia, one temperature record is chasing the next. While the zookeepers are busy cooling the elephants at Taronga Zoo, the rest of the team goes egg hunting with the penguins. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle face a big challenge together with the zookeepers. A disease has broken out in Longleat that is threatening animals and people. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: There is reason to be happy for Kate Humble and Ben Fogle. In Longleat you will find fantastic water landscapes - lots of fun for people and animals. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle will not soon forget this encounter in Longleat Park. They encounter a rather hungry lion. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Presenters Ben Fogle and Kate Humble observe the life of animals at Longleat Safari Park. This time they witness a romance between giant rodents. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle watch the wolves in Longleat Park. Which of the predators will become the new leader of the pack? (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: The carers are happy about the visit from Kate Humble and Ben Fogle. In today's episode, the moderators can be there when the employees play Cupid. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: A new, exciting project is beginning at Longleat Animal Park: a wolf forest. Of course, TV presenters Kate Humble and Ben Fogle don't miss the opening. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: A birthday party is on the agenda at Longleat Zoo: a legendary lion turns eighteen. Kate Humble and Ben Fogle celebrate with us. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle return to Longleat with sad hearts. Together with the zookeepers, the TV presenters have to say goodbye to a tiger. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: Happy baby at the San Diego Zoo: While the keepers are happy about the offspring of the endangered California condors, Klipspringer calf Kiddo needs help immediately after birth. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: Love is in the air at the San Diego Zoo. Male koala Hunter is ready for a new partner. Meanwhile, Jaws, the Galapagos tortoise, appears to be unwell. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: The animal keepers at the San Diego Zoo are looking for a partner for the baboon Impo. Two cheetah cubs are being trained to become ambassadors for the conservation of their relatives. (Station info).

programme.title: San Diego Zoo
programme.desc: Will the zookeepers be able to prepare the impetuous black rhino Aria for her new life in the outdoor enclosure? A vulture chick learns from its "surrogate parents.

programme.title: Battle of the giants – lions against elephants
programme.desc: Fight for survival: Africa's largest herd of elephants meets a pride of young lions. Extreme drought makes the starving big cats more willing to take risks. (Station info).

programme.title: Big cats
programme.desc: From Africa's savannahs to South Asia, Bertie Carvel shows the diversity of big cats: In Ruaha National Park, lions hunt in packs, while in Sri Lanka's forests tiny rusty cats explore their territory alone. The film portrays species and their amazing survival strategies. \n\n3 parts, Saturdays.

programme.title: Jaguars: Brazil's shadow hunters
programme.desc: In Brazil's wilderness, researchers are fighting for the survival of endangered jaguars. Two orphaned young animals are to be released into the wild - a risky project with an uncertain outcome. (Station info).

programme.title: Fascination Africa
programme.desc: The nature reserve in the Luangwa Valley is located in eastern Zambia. Here, the magnificent natural landscape becomes an uncomfortable place for the numerous animal inhabitants during the dry season. (Station info).

programme.title: Großkatzen 24/7
programme.desc: The flood brings prey and danger: wildlife filmmaker Gordon Buchanan accompanies a pride of lions on the hunt, while cameraman Brad Bestelink observes a leopard seeking protection for her cub. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild dogs: hunters between worlds
programme.desc: People are committed to protecting rare wild dogs and foxes. They prevent deadly dangers in South Africa and save the tiny Darwin fox from extinction. (Station info).

programme.title: Tropical islands of our world
programme.desc: Madagascar: Home to unique species such as ring-tailed lemurs and the Labord's chameleon. But human influence is changing nature faster than many animals can adapt. (Station info).

programme.title: Tropical islands of our world
programme.desc: Sun bears or proboscis monkeys: Borneo is home to over 60,000 species of animals and plants. But the destruction of forests by humans is increasingly threatening their habitat. (Station info).

programme.title: Tropical islands of our world
programme.desc: The O'opu nopili fish climbs up waterfalls and the sea turtle cleans its shell on reef fish. How can Hawaiians preserve this unique flora and fauna? (Station info).

programme.title: Kieling's Wild World
programme.desc: Climate change is threatening the koala and its main food source, eucalyptus, like never before. Fires and drought cause the koala to escape its natural habitat and move closer to civilization to find food. Animal filmmaker Andreas Kieling wants to know how animal rights activists can save marsupial mammals from danger.

programme.title: CELEBRITY IOU (S4)

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: VÕ TÒNG BÁO THÙ - WUSONG VS XIMENQING
programme.desc: Ngô Song phát hiện ra chuyện chị dâu ngoại tình với một người đàn ông giàu có, Tây Môn Khánh. Qing gài bẫy Song và đày anh ta trong một năm, trong thời gian đó người anh trai kém may mắn của anh ta bị sát hại và hỏa táng. Cuối cùng, khi Song trở về nhà, anh đưa vụ án ra tòa nhưng thẩm phán gạt nó sang một bên và đột ngột đóng lại. Liệu Song cuối cùng có thể trả thù cho cái chết của anh trai mình?

programme.title: ÔNG TRÙM, CẢNH SÁT VÀ TÊN XẢO QUYỆT - THE GANGSTER, THE COP, THE DEVIL
programme.desc: Phim được chuyển thể từ sự kiện có thật. Thám tử Lin thành lập một đơn vị đặc biệt để bắt giữ tên cướp xe máy và tổ chức tội phạm đứng sau vụ trộm ở Phật Sơn. Trong quá trình đó, người vợ đang mang thai của anh bị một tên cướp xe máy đâm phải, khiến anh phát hiện ra kế hoạch trả thù của chúng...

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: THIÊN THƯ - A SEALED BOOK
programme.desc: Thế giới chìm vào bóng tối khi một cuốn sách phong ấn, được cho là chỉ huy các lực lượng của vũ trụ, được khai quật trong một cung điện dưới lòng đất trên sa mạc. Khi các nhà thám hiểm chạy đua để giành lấy sức mạnh của nó, cánh cổng cung điện mở ra, gây ra một nỗi kinh hoàng vô hình và báo trước một thảm họa ngoài sức tưởng tượng.

programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: NỮ CẢNH SÁT ĐẶC NHIỆM - HIDDEN HEROINE

Mei Jing thuộc Đơn vị biệt kích nữ Thunderbolt, dẫn đầu nhóm của cô tấn công cơ sở ma túy, nhưng họ đang bị phục kích và danh tính nội gián của cha Mei bị lộ. Sau một trận chiến khốc liệt, Mei và nhóm của cô đã đánh bại thành công băng đảng ma túy và giải cứu cha cô.
